the presented control concept for AirArm works very well and is able to control the system with a high accuracy and a good dynamics.

the proposed control concept is suitable to control the AirArm and that the AirArm can be controlled to follow a desired trajectory with a desired compliance.

the design and implementation of a nonlinear control system, which can be used to control the position and the compliance of the joints of the AirArm.
the development of a new type of robotic system, which combines the advantages of both conventional and biological systems.
the development of a novel control concept for a compliant manipulator arm.

the presented control concept can be applied to any robot system that is driven by compliant actuators.

the presented control concept is a good basis for the control of the AirArm, which was successfully demonstrated during the Bionic Learning Network Challenge 2010.

we have successfully demonstrated that the presented model-based nonlinear control concept is a feasible solution for controlling the AirArm manipulator.
the AirArm can be considered as a very good platform to investigate the potential of pneumatic muscles in robotic applications.

the presented modeling and control concept for the AirArm is suitable for other compliant robot manipulators as well.
